newsitem.title: USA: Collagen unit sees strong sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Collagen unit sees strong sales, earnings.

text.p: Collagen Corp, which earlier announced the spin-off of its aesthetic technologies business, expects sales from that newly-formed company will grown 15 to 20 percent a year for the next 10 to 15 years, Collagen Chairman Howard Palefsky said.
The Aesthetic Technologies Group should show 20 to 40 percent annual growth in operating income over the next 10 to 15 years, Palefsky told the Hambrecht and Quist Healthcare conference here.
The strong growth will be fueled by dramatic increases in cosmetic reconstructive procedures, he said.
In addition, he projected strong demand for its vegetable oil-based breast implant, which is considered safer than silicone, while offering better visibility for mamogram patients.

"There has been a phenomenal response to (the implants), Palefsky said. He added the company received 10,000 phone calls of interest after a local news station in Los Angeles aired a story on the vegetable oil implants.
